# Standing brazier

Type: Furniture | Internal ID: piece_brazierfloor01 | Source: Forge | Usage: Coal, -fueled light source. | Crafting Materials: Bronze x5, Coal x2, Fenris claw x3 | Support: Wood (from 10 to 100) | Loss: 1/8 vertical, 1/5 horizontal | Other Effect(s): Produces smoke, Removes the Cold Effect, Adds the Fire Effect, Rapidly removes the Wet Effect, Reduces Freezing Effect to Cold Effect | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pierce, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Lightning | Immune to (x0): Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Poison, ,, Spirit

# Introduction

The Standing brazier is a light source that can be placed on any surface, and must be built within the range of a Forge.

## Usage

The Standing brazier has all the same functions as a Campfire and is a base structure.
Standing braziers are fueled with Coal. With 1/5 fuel, a Standing brazier will last for 5 hours and 33 minutes. At maximum capacity, a Standing brazier should burn for 27 hours and 47 minutes. It can be used for cooking, however, it does not fit easily like a Campfire does.
The Fire Effect for the Standing brazier extends for about 4–5 meters (Measured from the closest the player can stand without setting themselves on fire).

## Notes

• Destroying the Standing brazier with a Hammer will not yield back any Coal and will only return the 5 Bronze and 3 Fenris claws used for its construction. All Coal used as fuel and for the initial construction will not be dropped.
• Standing braziers found in Frost Caves can be destroyed for Coal and sometimes Bronze.
• Standing braziers stop working if exposed to rainy weather without a roof.
